goal: decision-models S4. Every offline decision eval shares one harness so corpus handling, metrics and calibration are computed the same way. Delegated choices: scripts/decision-eval/harness.ts owns JSONL corpus parsing with physical line numbers, gold label validation against a point's label set, accuracy (unavailable counted incorrect), per-option precision and recall, macro F1, a calibration section (multi-class Brier score averaged over cases with a decision, plus excluded count for unavailable cases), the baseline comparison and dated JSON and Markdown report writing. scripts/decision-eval/a14/run.ts becomes a thin caller of the harness; its report keeps every existing field and value and gains only the calibration section. No new application point.

acceptance.assertion: In tests/decision-eval-harness.test.ts: two cases whose decision gives probability 1 to the gold option yield Brier 0; one two-option case with probabilities 0.5/0.5 yields Brier 0.5; an unavailable case is excluded from Brier, counted in calibration.excluded and counted incorrect in accuracy; a corpus with a blank line 1 and an invalid gold label on line 2 is rejected with line 2 before any report is written; per-option precision is null for an option never predicted.
tests/decision-eval-a14.test.ts passes with its existing report assertions unchanged, and an added assertion shows the A14 report carries the calibration section.
